_help: Every rogue boss. The first block of fields is the One Piece Mod's own character format (see its characters.json): health, damage, Berries dropped (bounty), size, the two special attacks (power, hardPower: any of the main mod's BossAbility powers) and the Hard/Expert prizes. The rest is this mod's: hitbox ([width, height] in blocks before the size is applied, to fit its model), bountyReward (how much a first win raises your bounty), crew (an NPC kit from crews.json, or "" to fight alone), signature (the phase 3 move, see RogueSignatures.java), the lines it shouts, where its rumor drops (rumorFrom: main mod NPC kit ids) and its trophy. Optional: fruitItem (a main mod Devil Fruit dropped on a win, like its story bosses), beasts (entity ids, one or two called with each crew wave) and lairBeasts (creatures that live in its lair without joining the fight).

bosses.name: "Saltjaw" Gully Rourke
bosses.lore: A salvage pirate who drags his ship's anchor behind him on a chain. Wrecks anything he can sell for scrap.
bosses.intro: That ship of yours'd fetch a fine price as scrap!
bosses.phase2: Lads! Strip 'em down to the nails!
bosses.phase3: Down to the seabed with ya! Anchor's away!

bosses.name: Corvina, the Fog Widow
bosses.lore: Queen of a smuggling ring that only sails in fog. Ships that follow her lanterns are never seen again.
bosses.intro: Follow the lanterns, darling. Everyone does.
bosses.phase2: Lanterns up! Let them drown in the grey.
bosses.phase3: You can't strike what you can't see!

bosses.name: Commodore Hollis "Iron Tide" Graves
bosses.lore: A Navy commodore who deserted with his whole garrison and a hold full of seastone shot. Now he sells "protection" to islands the Navy forgot.
bosses.intro: Justice is a business now. And business is good.
bosses.phase2: Garrison! Form ranks on me!
bosses.phase3: Seastone volley! Let's see that fruit save you now!

bosses.name: Tsurugi, the Hollow Ronin
bosses.lore: An empty suit of samurai armor that still fights. Whoever wore it swore to duel until they lost, and never lost.
bosses.intro: ...Draw.
bosses.phase2: Your blade is honest. Again.
bosses.phase3: Hollow Cut. There is nothing left inside to stop it.

bosses.name: Boilerheart Gantz
bosses.lore: A shipbreaker who rebuilt himself around a ship's boiler. He eats coal, breathes steam and tears warships apart by hand.
bosses.intro: More coal! MORE COAL!
bosses.phase2: Stokers! Open every valve!
bosses.phase3: PRESSURE'S PAST THE RED! EVERYBODY DOWN!

bosses.name: Nereus Vane, Herald of the Deep
bosses.lore: A fishman prophet who says the sea itself speaks through him. His followers sink ships as offerings to something far below.
bosses.intro: The deep has been waiting for you.
bosses.phase2: Rise, faithful! The tide answers!
bosses.phase3: Tidal Judgment! Let the sea take back what's hers!

bosses.name: Khamsin "Sandshackle" Rahd
bosses.lore: A desert warlord who chains every caravan he catches and sets them digging for a buried city's gold. His whip-chains are the shackles of everyone who ever escaped him.
bosses.intro: Another pair of hands for the dig. Kneel, and I'll go easy on the chains.
bosses.phase2: Raiders! Bring the irons!
bosses.phase3: Sandshackle Storm! Choke on the desert, then dig in it!

bosses.name: Captain Mortimer Gale of the Gilded Wake
bosses.lore: A treasure hunter who stole a cursed hoard and sank with it. He and his crew can't die until every coin is spent, and they will never spend a single one.
bosses.intro: Ahoy, thief. Every coin aboard is spoken for... and so are you.
bosses.phase2: All hands! The Wake's been boarded!
bosses.phase3: The Doubloon's Curse! Your years for my gold!
bosses.defeat: At last... the debt... is paid...

bosses.name: "Tidebreaker" Vasco Morrow, the Sea King Tamer
bosses.lore: A pirate who broke a young Sea King to the saddle and rides it into battle. His pens hold monsters the Navy still calls legends.
bosses.intro: Easy, girl... Looks like supper swam right up to us!
bosses.phase2: Wranglers! Open the pens!
bosses.phase3: Leviathan Charge! Nobody outruns the sea!
bosses.defeat: Whoa... whoa, girl... she's thrown me...

bosses.name: Dr. Aldous Kreuz, the Prototype Doctor
bosses.lore: A Navy scientist thrown out for testing weapons on his own soldiers. He stole the first Pacifista plans and builds his own on a hidden island, each prototype more dangerous and less finished than the last.
bosses.intro: A live specimen! Hold still. This will only hurt for the rest of your life.
bosses.phase2: Prototypes, activate! Data! I need DATA!
bosses.phase3: Every prototype, full output! Fire until the readings stop!

bosses.name: Gild Tesoro, the Golden Emperor
bosses.lore: Owner of the Gran Tesoro, a casino-ship as big as a country. The Gold-Gold Fruit lets him command any gold he has touched, and everyone aboard has touched his gold.
bosses.intro: Welcome to the Gran Tesoro! Tonight, the house always wins.
bosses.phase2: Security! Escort our guest to the gold vault... permanently.
bosses.phase3: Gold Gold Finale! Become a statue in my collection!
bosses.defeat: Impossible... I paid for this ending...

bosses.name: Uta, the World's Diva
bosses.lore: The world's most beloved singer. Anyone who hears her Sing-Sing Fruit song falls asleep into Uta World, a dream she never means to let them leave.
bosses.intro: Everyone listen! This next song is just for you!
bosses.phase2: My fans won't let you ruin the concert!
bosses.phase3: Tot Musica... play the final song with me!

bosses.name: "Z", Admiral Zephyr of the Neo Marines
bosses.lore: A former Navy Admiral who never ate a fruit and trained a generation of Marines. Now he leads the Neo Marines with a seastone arm, the Battle Smasher, to end the Pirate Era for good.
bosses.intro: Pirates... every last one of you will be wiped out.
bosses.phase2: Neo Marines! Show them what real justice looks like!
bosses.phase3: Battle Smasher! Feel the seastone, pirate!
bosses.defeat: So this... is the new era...

bosses.name: Douglas Bullet, the Demon Heir
bosses.lore: A former Roger Pirate who only believes in strength. The Clank-Clank Fruit fuses every scrap of metal around him into armour, and then into a war machine as big as a castle.
bosses.intro: Show me if you're strong. The weak don't get to live in my world.
bosses.phase2: Not enough! Hit me like you mean it!
bosses.phase3: Clank-Clank! Gashapon Fortress! Can you break THIS?!

bosses.name: Shiki, the Golden Lion
bosses.lore: The legendary pirate who broke out of Impel Down by cutting off his own legs; swords stand in their place. The Float-Float Fruit lifts his islands into the sky, where his mutated beasts wait.
bosses.intro: Jihahaha! So you're the brat making waves down there!
bosses.phase2: Come, my beasts! Supper's flown in!
bosses.phase3: Shishi Ikari! The sky itself falls on you!

bosses.name: El Drago, the Golden Roar
bosses.lore: A gold-mad pirate captain in gold-alloy armour. The Goe Goe Fruit turns his yell into a blast that blows holes in castles, and he's tearing Gold Island apart for Woonan's treasure.
bosses.intro: GOLD! Every last coin on this island is MINE!
bosses.phase2: Golass! Hyenas! Bury these brats under the gold!
bosses.phase3: Goe Goe! Hear me ROAR!

bosses.name: Gasparde, the Navy's Greatest Stain
bosses.lore: A Navy officer who deserted to run the Dead End race and steal its prize money. The Ame Ame Fruit turns him into thick candy syrup: it sticks to you, sets hard as spikes, and only flour stops it.
bosses.intro: Power is everything. The sea, the race, your life... I'll take them all.
bosses.phase2: Needless! Gasparde Pirates! Finish them!
bosses.phase3: Drown in my syrup! Struggle all you like, it only sets harder!
bosses.defeat: Beaten... by a pirate playing at pirates...

bosses.name: Baron Omatsuri
bosses.lore: The smiling host of Omatsuri Island, a resort of games called the Trials of Hell. The little flower on his shoulder, Lily Carnation, raised his lost crew from the dead, and it feeds on the pirates who lose.
bosses.intro: Welcome to Omatsuri Island! Shall we play a little game?
bosses.phase2: Red Arrows! Our guests want to stay forever!
bosses.phase3: Lily, sing! Let the arrows fall like rain!

bosses.name: Dr. Ratchet, Lord of Mecha Island
bosses.lore: The young feudal lord of Mecha Island, a giant sea turtle with Karakuri Castle on its shell. He builds clockwork war machines, rocket claws and drill arms, and means to rule the world with them.
bosses.intro: You're on MY island now. Let me show you what genius looks like!
bosses.phase2: Guards! Wind up the machines!
bosses.phase3: Super Zogame-kun! Fire every cannon!
bosses.defeat: My inventions... Mother's going to kill me...

bosses.name: Byrnndi World, Destroyer of the World
bosses.lore: Captain of the World Pirates, broken out of Impel Down to destroy the world. The Moa Moa Fruit makes anything he throws a hundred times faster and bigger: a pebble lands like a meteor.
bosses.intro: Barorororo! Friends are just tools. Let me show you what real power is!
bosses.phase2: World Pirates! Tear them apart!
bosses.phase3: Moa Moa! A hundred times! Watch the sky fall!

bosses.name: Bear King of the Trump Pirates
bosses.lore: Captain of the Trump Siblings, who seized Clockwork Island and the city on top of its great clock tower. The Kachi Kachi Fruit hardens his body like stone and heats his fists until they burn, and the King Cannon fires drilling shells.
bosses.intro: Welcome to Clockwork Island! The Trump Pirates take whatever they like, and today that's you.
bosses.phase2: Trump Siblings! Deal them in!
bosses.phase3: Kachi Kachi! Hot Boiling Special!
bosses.defeat: My body... was harder than stone...

bosses.name: Buena Festa, the Festival Pirate
bosses.lore: The 'Festival Pirate' who staged the Pirates Expo on Delta Island and baited every pirate in the world with Roger's treasure. He lives for one last, greatest festival, and lit the fuse with fireworks.
bosses.intro: Welcome, welcome to the Pirates Festival! Tonight, you're the main event!
bosses.phase2: Festival Pirates! Bring on the crowd!
bosses.phase3: The grand finale! Let the fireworks light up the whole sea!
bosses.defeat: What a festival... what a show...

bosses.name: Saga of the Seven Star Sword
bosses.lore: Zoro's childhood friend from the dojo, who drew the cursed Seven Star Sword from its shrine on Asuka Island. Under the red moon the sword moved his crippled arm again, and now it fights through him with green fire.
bosses.intro: This sword chose me. Under the red moon, nobody can stand against it.
bosses.phase2: Swordsmen! Take them!
bosses.phase3: Youkazan! Dark Fire Slash!
bosses.defeat: The sword's voice... it's quiet at last...

bosses.name: Count Butler, the Horn Eater
bosses.lore: A self-styled genius inventor and zoologist who came to Crown Island to eat the golden horns of its animal king. His violin hypnotises beasts and men; the horns turn him into a giant golden beast with fiery horns.
bosses.intro: A pirate? On my island of specimens? You'll make a fine addition to the collection.
bosses.phase2: General Hotdog! President Heaby! Deal with them!
bosses.phase3: The golden horns are mine! Behold the king of all beasts!
